description.html: This water dish has a light grey rock texture and a low, flat profile, so it does not stand out too much in the terrarium. It is shaped to fit easily into a corner, and one inside corner has a ribbed ramp, like a step, that leads from the bottom to the rim.

The ramp makes it easier to reach the water and to get out. Short-legged animals, hatchlings and tortoises do not have to climb over the edge, and insects that fall in can crawl out. The ribs on the ramp give feet and claws a grip, even when wet.
The corner shape is especially practical in smaller terrariums, where every bit of floor space matters for movement, hides and the basking zone.

Place the dish in the cooler corner of the terrarium with the ramp facing inward. Let it sit directly on the floor or on well-leveled substrate so it does not wobble. Change the water every day and occasionally clean the ramp ribs with a small brush.
